TI.P:
Order of the General Court (Sixth Chamber) of16 December 2019–
Kipper v Commission

INDEX.KEYWORD: Independent service provider for the Commission (free-lance)
Application for social benefits granted to officials in category B

TXT.KEYWORD: Dispute arising from contracts of employment concluded outside the scope of the Staff Regulations and the Conditions of Employment of Other Servants and not containing an arbitration clause
Lack of jurisdiction of the General Court

SUBJECT.P: Application for various social benefits granted to officials in category B.

NP.TXT: The action is dismissed for having been brought before a court that has no jurisdiction to hear it.
Mr Michael Kipper is ordered to pay the costs.
